name: agint-family-panel
description: AGINT family panel: v1 native docked panel (groups, row state, live signals) where every row opens a single-plugin dossier (identity / contract / wiring / measured output / debt / changelog), plus a v2 full-page board (Q1 dependency topology / Q2 measured output / Q3 decay verdicts) served from the same loopback host half. Data is computed live from source scanning (L0.5) and the three DSH_HOME storages, with TTL+mtime caching and per-source degradation; the dossier layer merges every physical location of one plugin id and reports only checkable structural drift.
